label: Actual productive path credit licenses causation of the same bearer in the same respect
paraphrase: Open one-way interpretation bridge. When a source has ExerciseContribution.Credit for a patient in a given respect on the specified exercise record and event-to-respect map, that same source bears the external CausesIn relation to the same patient in that respect. Establishing the interpretation requires genuine productive transmission under the attribution in question; mere enabling, an accidental path or a convenient reassignment of labels does not justify it.
